stances_toward.note: Self-governing part of the Realm (home rule since 1948). The Greenland crisis put Faroese autonomy talks on hold in early 2026 - Faroese leaders judged it was not the time to negotiate with Copenhagen - while independence moved up the local agenda. Faroese parties also support Frederiksen's third government in the Folketing. Bond - kin: the Realm and the Nordic community.

relations_to.summary: The Faroe Islands are a self-governing part of the Realm (home rule since 1948). In early 2026 Faroese leaders put heavy negotiations with Copenhagen on hold because of the Greenland crisis; independence moved up the local agenda.
